DATA_COMP: From January 1953 onwards: end-of-month balance for total assets following the methodological specifications of the Bank of Japan Accounts. Before 1953: end-of-year balance for total assets as shown in 'Meiji iko hompo shuyo keizai tokei [Hundred-year statistics of the Japanese economy] (edition 1966)'.
COLLECTION_DETAIL: From January 1953 onwards, figures show the end-of-month balance for total assets of the Bank of Japan for each month. The series follows the methodological specifications of the Bank of Japan Accounts. Annual data are consistent with the monthly series as December observations. Quarterly data are consistent with the monthly series and are sourced from the end of quarter (March, June, September, and December) observations. Before 1953: end-of-year balance for total assets as shown in "Meiji iko hompo shuyo keizai tokei [Hundred-year statistics of the Japanese economy] (edition 1966)". The number of digits after the decimal point differs depending on the year due to changes in the unit value of original data (from 1946 onwards: 100 million yen; between 1911 and 1945: million yen; before 1911: thousand yen). From December 1893: items listed in the reports on "Treasury and government funds" and "National banknotes redemption account" are not included due to the separation of those items from the balance sheet of the Bank of Japan.
COMPILING_ORG: Bank of Japan; Bank for International Settlements.
TITLE: Japan - Central bank, assets, total, BIS-spliced
